notebook.targets: diurnal residual with warmer night and cooler daytime supply than the fixed-setpoint PI

notebook.expr: T_room + kp * (where(weekday() >= d_we, sp - drop, sp) - T_room) + integral(where(weekday() >= d_we, sp - drop, sp) - T_room, ti)

notebook.expr: where(T_out < t_break, level + slope * T_out + boost, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: Outdoor-reset curve with a cold-weather boost or steeper low-end segment, as frost protection or cold-snap pickup; raises supply only below an outdoor breakpoint.
notebook.targets: positive residual in very cold and cold outdoor bands
notebook.refute: If fitted boost is negligible, breakpoint sits outside the cold bands, or cold-band residual remains positive.

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= n_start) & (hour_of_day() < n_end), level + slope * T_out - drop, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: Clock-based daytime setback or solar-gain compensation: controller lowers the supply-temperature request during a midday window, independent of outdoor reset.
notebook.targets: negative residual concentrated in midday hours
notebook.refute: If fitted window is not midday, drop is negligible, or hour-of-day residual pattern persists.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(T_out > t_hi, level + slope * T_out - drop, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: Warm-weather high-limit or summer changeover that does not turn heat fully off but reduces the supply-temperature request above a warm outdoor threshold.
notebook.targets: negative residual in warm outdoor band and late-spring overprediction
notebook.refute: If threshold falls outside the warm band, drop is negligible, or warm-band residual does not improve.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((month() >= m_spring) & (month() <= m_spring), level + slope * T_out - spring_drop, where((month() >= m_fall) & (month() <= m_fall), level + slope * T_out + fall_boost, level + slope * T_out))
notebook.mechanism: Calendar-based seasonal trim in the building automation system: a spring setback before summer changeover and a fall boost when heating resumes, giving asymmetric shoulder-season behavior.
notebook.targets: large negative residual in late spring and positive residual in early fall
notebook.refute: If fitted spring month is not late spring, fall month is not early fall, or either trim is negligible.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: level + slope * T_out + kp * (sp - T_room) + integral(sp - T_room, ti)
notebook.mechanism: weather-compensated supply temperature with a room-temperature proportional-plus-integral trim, as in an outdoor-reset controller with room feedback
notebook.targets: midday negative residual shape and outdoor-band curvature through room-temperature feedback
notebook.refute: if the fitted room gain and integral time are negligible, or if held-out error does not improve over the plain outdoor-reset and room-proportional forms, or if the midday residual shape remains
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(T_out < t_lo, level + slope * T_out + boost, where(T_out > t_hi, level + slope * T_out - drop, level + slope * T_out))
notebook.mechanism: dual-slope weather compensation: extra cold-weather boost below a low outdoor breakpoint and reduced supply above a warm-weather high limit
notebook.targets: positive residual in the cold outdoor band and negative residual in the warm outdoor band
notebook.refute: if the fitted boost or drop is negligible, or if the breakpoints collapse, or if held-out error is not better than the separate cold-boost and warm-drop forms
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(ema(T_out, tau) > cutoff, level + slope * T_out - drop, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: high-limit outdoor-reset reduction driven by filtered outdoor temperature, so warm spells and shoulder-season warming lower the supply curve without fully switching heat off
notebook.targets: shoulder-month negative residual and warm outdoor-band overprediction
notebook.refute: if the filter time or cutoff is not identifiable, or if the fitted drop is negligible, or if a full-off high-limit form explains the residual better
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((month() >= m_change) & (month() <= m_change), level + slope * T_out - drop, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: seasonal changeover or reduced heating-curve level during a shoulder month, as in a controller with a calendar-based summer/winter changeover
notebook.targets: large negative residual concentrated in a shoulder month
notebook.refute: if the fitted changeover month is not the shoulder month with the residual, or if the drop is negligible, or if a multi-month seasonal range explains the residual better
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)
